input.name: Read member name and share balances
input.description: Logs into the CoreServ 7.2.14 back-office console, looks up a member by full member number on the Member Lookup screen, and returns the member's name plus the current balances of their savings and checking shares from the Member Summary screen. Outputs: memberName (full name of the member, PII), savingsBalance (current balance of the Savings share, e.g. "Primary Savings"), checkingBalance (current balance of the Checking share, e.g. "Everyday Checking"). Read-only — it opens no sub-accounts and submits no changes.
input.whenToUse: Use when an agent or [secret] needs a quick, authoritative read of a credit-union member's identity and deposit balances for servicing, verification, or reporting — given an exact member number.
input.notFor: Not for partial-name or fuzzy member searches, not for loan/credit-card details, and not for any balance-changing operation (transfers, sub-account opening, card services). Members without a savings or checking share will not yield those outputs.

params.name: memberNumber
params.description: The full member number to look up, e.g. "***0001". Partial numbers are not accepted by the lookup screen.
